nodes.label: CISCU Member Logo
nodes.description: SVG logo for CISCU, a member/partner organization of lanube coworking space. Square format (363x363px) with a dark navy/blue background (#364462) and white stylized letterforms spelling 'CISCU'. The logo uses geometric vector paths to render the acronym in a clean, modern typographic style. Used as a member institution logo on the landing page.
